 |Phi(x_m)-Phi(x)|<=2(N+N0)m b_R+m^2 b_R^2.
The endpoint payoff is bounded on this finite path set. The preceding total variation estimate yields
 |(P_tilde^m Phi-Phi)(x)-(P^m Phi-Phi)(x)|
 <=8delta m^2 b_R(N+N0)+4delta m^3 b_R^2.                    (1)
For a FIXED m depending only on R, this is C_R delta(N+N0+1).
